headline: Washington outscores every conference rival
dek: After winning at West Virginia, Washington has 46 goals against 22 conceded, with twelve wins and four losses on its record. Midfielder Zach Ramsey has driven that attack, scoring nineteen goals and setting up six more.
displaced_by: Indiana's draw with Missouri State invalidated the standing dek's draw and shutout counts; Washington's win at West Virginia extended its conference-leading goal total to 46.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Goals have tracked the foot of the table more closely than its top: Michigan and Penn State, the only programs without a conference win, have scored the fewest, while the table leader is not the side that has scored the most.

wire.line: Indiana has lost once all season, with Michal Mroz keeping nine shutouts and conceding thirteen goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ohio State's home match with Indianapolis, dated in August, is the one match in the conference past its date with no result published.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Laurin Mack has made 87 saves in Maryland's goal, posting a .757 save percentage.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Seventeen different players have scored for Rutgers this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Michigan's three wins this season have all come outside the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wisconsin has won eleven matches and lost only three, scoring 40 goals while conceding eighteen.

last_match.line: Back-to-back shutout wins for Washington, which has not lost since falling at UCLA early in November.

next_match.line: Georgetown has already beaten Rutgers and lost at Maryland this season; UCLA arrives off a home win over Omaha.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
